question: All of the following are true about Nizatidine except

options.opa: It is a H2 blocker used in peptic ulcer disease
options.opd: It can also lead to tachycardia

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Nizatidine" -> "H2 blocker" -> "used in peptic ulcer disease" -> 95%
analysis: Nizatidine is a histamine H2 receptor antagonist used in the treatment of peptic ulcer disease, which is well-documented and aligns with standard medical knowledge. The claim that Nizatidine has 100% bioavailability is incorrect, as its bioavailability is approximately 70%. There is no strong evidence or consensus supporting the idea that Nizatidine enhances gastric emptying, making this statement questionable. Tachycardia is not a common side effect of Nizatidine, but it can occur as a rare side effect, although this is not well-documented. Therefore, the statement about 100% bioavailability is the exception among the options provided.
